detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This Is A Short Game!!

About:

King Toad ate another frog...

After eating a gun, even a small frog like yourself might be able to take him down though. Gun Frog is a unique movement shooter filled with fun characters and thrilling combat. Bounce on lily pads and shoot flies as you explore a vibrant world on an epic journey to defeat King Toad.

Features:

  • Fast paced physics based movement and combat.
  • 7 unique bosses and locations
  • A wide range of silly characters
  • Lots of frogs
